question: In which of the following Sessions of the IOC Executive Board Meeting was Brisbane voted to host the 2032 Olympics and Paralympics?
solution:
The correct answer is__** 138th**____** Session held in Tokyo**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• 138th Session held in Tokyo:- 

 
 
• **Brisbane was voted to host the 2032 Olympics and Paralympics at the 138th IOC Session on 21 July 2021 in Tokyo, Japan.**
 
• Following changes in the bidding rules, the International Olympic Committee selected and announced Brisbane as the winning bid on 21 July 2021, two days before the start of the 2020 Summer Olympics.
 
• Brisbane was first announced as the preferred bid on 24 February 2021, gaining the formal approval of the IOC Executive Board on 10 June 2021.
 
• Brisbane became the first host city to be selected to host the Olympics through the new bid process.
 
• The 138th IOC Session was held under strict COVID-19 restrictions, and the vote was held in a secret ballot. Brisbane received 72 yes and 5 no votes from 77 valid votes.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **140th Session of the International Olympic Committee:-**

 
 
• It will be held in Mumbai, India from October 15 to 17, 2023.
 
• This will be the second time that India has hosted an IOC Session, the first being in New Delhi in 1983.
 
 
 
• **139th Session of the International Olympic Committee:-**
 
 
• It was held in Beijing, China on February 3 and 19, 2022 and in Lausanne, Switzerland on May 20, 2022.
 
• The Session was held just ahead of the 2022 Winter Olympic Games in Beijing.

• **137th IOC Session:-**
 
 
• It was held in Lausanne, Switzerland from March 10 to 12, 2021.
 
• The Session was held virtually due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
